note: Two declared splits match no delivered column: 1.5.other, and 1.5.kon-1, whose suffix extends the bound split's (the replaced unique-suffix test's answer / answer-1 pair). The bound kon split still takes Kon and KON; LEFT, which no split names, stays on the native family. The unmatched splits get no state and each is reported as a stale_curation_entry at its [[variable]] pin, as when every literal is bound (split-partition-split-naming-stale-when-it-matches-no-delivered-column); before that fix they were silently unused here. The replaced unique-suffix test also asserted the `split_identity_conversion_pending` code and its detail: without an [[identity.partition]] the build drops that diagnostic, and with one it is never raised, so it has no build form.
fails_if: an unmatched declared split (1.5.other or 1.5.kon-1) makes `convert_column_partitions` withhold the whole native family, so the bound Kon/KON twins lose their kon states or are reported ambiguous; or the split suffix is matched by prefix, so kon-1 also claims Kon/KON and is not reported stale; or `compile_partitions` stops reporting an unmatched split pin as a stale entry when a native row is still unresolved beside it; or an unmatched literal is assigned to a split, so LEFT leaves the native family (the build then refuses: the pending splits need a native remainder)

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers Kon in 2020 (CVID 20), KON in 2021 (CVID 21) and LEFT in 2021 (CVID 22).
